text: Experts say that general AI, also called AGI, could change our world completely. Unlike today's AI, AGI would think and learn like a human. It might solve big problems, such as curing diseases or fighting climate change. However, there are serious risks too. Some people worry that AGI could take away jobs or even become dangerous if we lose control of it. When will AGI arrive? Nobody knows for sure. Some experts predict it could happen in 20 to 30 years, while others think it is much further away. One thing is clear: we need to talk about it now.
